name: PBSS106_Undine
description: U-class submarines were conceived as unarmed targets for anti-submarine training, but after the project had been approved, a decision was made to arm them with torpedoes. The fore-end was redesigned to accommodate six torpedo tubes. The submarines relied on electric motors to move, and they used diesel engines as generators. When World War II broke out, Undine participated in missions as part of the 6th Submarine Flotilla. On January 7, 1940, she was sunk by German auxiliary minesweepers.

consumables.name: Damage Control Party
consumables.description:
Extinguishes fires, removes instances of flooding, and repairs damaged modules.
Prevents enemy acoustic torpedoes from homing.

consumables.name: Hydrophone
consumables.description: Highlights the positions of ships and submarines on the surface or at periscope depth that are beyond spotting range. Ship positions are ascertained at the moment you activate the consumable.

consumables.name: Submarine Surveillance
consumables.description: Detects submarines at maximum and periscope depths.
